config.audioAnalysis: Reuse the existing FFmpeg/SciPy percussion-weighted spectral-flux approach. Analyze 45–220 Hz, 300–2200 Hz and 2500–7000 Hz independently; retain numerical values at every scene boundary.

score.aggregate: Arithmetic mean over every internal scene boundary; do not exclude low-scoring cuts. First frame and final endpoint are not internal cuts.
score.beatEvidence: Only detected percussive onsets within 75ms of the independently estimated local beat grid qualify as observed beats. Interpolated grid points alone never qualify.
score.zeroEvidence: A cut without an observed beat within 150ms receives zero timing points. Silence cannot earn onset-support points.

gate.negativeControl: Also score the existing sequence and a 250ms delayed cut schedule using the identical scorer. Publish all scores.
gate.detailWork: Locked until the numeric gate passes AND a full rough cut implements the changing shots. Passing timing does not certify oneness, story, sync perception, or creative acceptance.

config.limitations: Percussion estimates can retain vocal transients; tempo octave and phase may be ambiguous. Estimated beats are evidence with uncertainty, not manually verified downbeats. Musical pacing and visible scene changes require a separate full playback check.
